_comment: Type checking for a JavaScript project, with no TypeScript in it.
checkJs turns JSDoc into a real type system and catches the class of bug that survives
review most easily: a function called with the wrong shape. Agents produce these
constantly, because they infer a signature from a name.
strict is on. Turning it off to make the first run quiet defeats the purpose — fix the
findings or exclude a directory, but do not lower the bar globally.
